findings.evidence: `rg` confirms the declaration at `Prod.lean:138`; lines 141-142 show the actual lhs is `Prod.map ... x = ...`, unlike `prodHom_apply_apply` at lines 77-79 which applies `prodHom` itself.
findings.fix: Change the theorem statement to apply the relative homomorphism, e.g. `((relativeProdHom (I := I) (J := J) (n := n) s t p : (M × N) ≃ₘ^n⟮I.prod J, I.prod J⟯ M × N) x) = ((p.1 : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) x.1, (p.2 : N ≃ₘ^n⟮J, J⟯ N) x.2)`.
findings.issue: `relativeProdHom_apply_apply` is documented and named as the pointwise formula for `relativeProdHom`, but its statement only proves the definitional identity for `Prod.map` and never mentions `relativeProdHom`.

summary: One advertised pointwise API theorem for the relative product homomorphism does not state anything about the relative product homomorphism, so the PR leaves a mis-formalized helper under a misleading name.
